assets.figure: Figure 2, complete method figure and caption
english_bullets: Action Observability Gramian ranks action-sensitive directions.
Action-Subspace Protection keeps selected directions at higher precision.
assets.speaker_notes_zh: Q-WAM 先用 Action Observability Gramian 衡量各层舍入误差沿后续去噪步骤对动作的影响，再把高敏感方向放进 16-bit 分支、量化剩余方向。其 action mass 决定保护资源放在哪个 expert。Q-WAM 的结果表不是 LIBERO Fast-WAM 对照，不纳入下面的 W4A4 同名 baseline 数值比较。

assets.speaker_notes_zh: SteerQuant 用 action-impact stream map 找到动作敏感的 token/timestep stream；离线阶段共享权重误差路由并做 stream-specific activation modulation，在线低位宽推理由 Rudder 执行。图注区分离线权重准备与融合推理 kernel。

assets.speaker_notes_zh: Fast-WAM Figure 2 展示 video DiT 与 action DiT 的联合训练及 structured attention mask；推理侧以当前帧和动作序列为条件，不要求 test-time future imagination。它是 QuantWAMs 原始 Fast-WAM 与 SteerQuant FastWAMJoint 名称/结构背景，不足以单独证明两个实验 checkpoint 完全相同。

w4a4_comparison.row_scope: All W4A4 rows reported for the two LIBERO Fast-WAM-family result tables
w4a4_comparison.protocol_caveat: Do not call the discrepancy an error from these tables alone. QuantWAMs reports original Fast-WAM with 6,000 LIBERO episodes over three protocol seeds and 32 complete calibration trajectories; SteerQuant reports FastWAMJoint with 2,000 rollouts and uses 100 LIBERO training observations for calibration. Model/checkpoint variant, calibration data, evaluation seeds/episode accounting, and inference settings are not shown to be identical. The tables support a large reported difference, but identifying its cause requires an aligned protocol.
w4a4_comparison.missing_baselines: RTN and OmniQuant are not rows in either of these two LIBERO result tables. Q-WAM's reported evaluation is not a LIBERO Fast-WAM result, so it does not supply another comparable row.
w4a4_comparison.footnote_context: SteerQuant's full-table caption states that LIBERO Avg. is the mean across four suites. The zoom panel retains all suite/Avg headers; the full screenshot retains the complete caption.

qat_prior_art.finding: A bounded primary-source search did not verify direct WAM-control quantization-aware training (QAT). This is not a claim that no such work exists.
qat_prior_art.search_scope: ArXiv primary-source search for quantization-aware training with world-action/WAM control terms, followed by inspection of relevant WAM quantization papers. Existing direct WAM results found in this set are PTQ-oriented.
